python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("src/types/checker/builtin_spl_classes/filesystem.rs")
s = p.read_text()
old = '''    let mut body = vec![
        assign_stmt("path", string_expr("php://temp")),
        assign_stmt(
            "backing",
            binary_expr(
                string_expr("php://temp/maxmemory:"),
                BinOp::Concat,
                var_expr("maxMemory"),
            ),
        ),
        if_stmt(
            binary_expr(var_expr("maxMemory"), BinOp::Lt, int_expr(0)),
            vec![
                assign_stmt("path", string_expr("php://memory")),
                assign_stmt("backing", string_expr("php://memory")),
            ],
            None,
        ),
    ];'''
new = '''    let mut body = vec![if_stmt(
        binary_expr(var_expr("maxMemory"), BinOp::Lt, int_expr(0)),
        vec![
            assign_stmt("path", string_expr("php://memory")),
            assign_stmt("backing", string_expr("php://memory")),
        ],
        Some(vec![
            assign_stmt("path", string_expr("php://temp")),
            assign_stmt(
                "backing",
                binary_expr(
                    string_expr("php://temp/maxmemory:"),
                    BinOp::Concat,
                    cast_expr(CastType::String, var_expr("maxMemory")),
                ),
            ),
        ]),
    )];'''
assert s.count(old) == 1, s.count(old)
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
print("branches restructured")
